The case model includes managing details of parking lots, implicitly holding available space information.

The use case 'Handle Vehicle Arrival' involves retrieving vehicle data through GS and checking it against database records.
The 'Handle Vehicle Arrival' use case includes opening the barrier through GS actions when a vehicle is recognized.
Clients are directed to 'Register/Update Client & Vehicle' when automatic entry is hindered, providing further instructions at the entrance.
The use case 'Register/Update Client & Vehicle' includes the client providing personal and vehicle data through photos.

After crossing the barrier, clients drive and secure their vehicles on open conveyors as indicated in the process.
The 'Conveyors' Controller' assigns conveyors post vehicle arrival and executes optimization for parking spot allocation.
Parking spaces and conveyors are largely detailed, denoting placement by floor coordinates facilitating vehicle organization.
The system accounts for parking spaces defined by size, accommodating specific vehicle classifications.
Conveyor weight limits are considered in assigning vehicles, per control actions in optimizing space use.
In the use case for optimization, both space size and weight limits are accounted for in finding appropriate spaces.
The CC updates the system once a vehicle reaches its intended parking spot, recording completion and location.
The system's capabilities include knowing exact vehicle locations within the infrastructure at any time.
Clients receive SMS updates containing the details of their parking sessions.
System UI enables client access to parking details through mobile input.
The system retains conveyor data only as long as the parking session is active.
Clients initiate retrieval actions using the UI, with validations based on vehicle and phone numbers.
Conveyors are allocated to return vehicles at session end toward the lot gate.
Payments are completed through interactions within the system's user interface.
Payment calculations utilize price lists that integrate IRS-delivered data for amounts due.

Pricing history is systematized for each parking lot to track changes over time.

Issued receipts document transaction summaries, including rates, summaries, and total costs.
The system incorporates management functions for a customer club offering member benefits.

Membership is represented as perpetual and cost-free within the system design.

Members receive a complimentary parking session at their selected lots within the registration month.
The system supports generating specific reports as directed by administrative tasks.
Reports cover a yearly view of income, with financial summaries and relevant metrics.
Annual reports include detailed parking lot metrics regarding financial and color-based vehicle data.
Report data is logically arranged to facilitate analysis by location and financial totals.
Reports have options to be exported in PDF or XML formats for varied distribution needs.
Monthly reports track customer club membership changes and statistics over time.
Club growth reports offer monthly insights into membership fluctuation, growth, and active status.
The customer club growth report's arrangement by month presents a chronological view of memberships.
